name: @cyberdeck/cyberdeck
description: Cyberdeck, the engine: imports stories, previews them with Datajack's stage, exports them as games

scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop-tests.json
scripts.build:desktop: vite build && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode main && vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts --mode preload
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && node ../desktop/scripts/packageApp.mjs Cyberdeck cyberdeck
scripts.package:desktop:windows: npm run build:desktop && node ../desktop/scripts/packageApp.mjs Cyberdeck cyberdeck win32
